steps.note: S1.1.1-S1.1.2 state that rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-7 add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx) and restore c,a, so the net change (JV+RG)x does not depend on a,c, as at lines 744-750.
S1.1.3 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side injection cancelling the intersection-one cases, intersections zero and two contributing zero, and self coefficient one.
S1.1.4 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, cancelled by the side wires for intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S1.1.5 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) through forward, inverse and forward invocations, with every scratch wire restored.

The plan says every edge joins comparable labels and that a residual's dimension is the change in label dimension (S1.3.1, S1.4.1.1), but it never gives the per-edge residuals or their dimensions from the table (e.g. B tensor t_X-perp of dimension (a-1)(h-1)).

S1.3.5 states the side-wire inclusion P tensor <t_X> in P tensor t_Y-perp from t_X perp t_Y (quoting line 953), but it never states the complement <t_X,t_Y>-perp of dimension h-2 that gives the residual of edge 2->5.
The S1.4.1 substeps state the only decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), telescoping at gates, sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute Wm-2N+2L, with L=Ich.

S1.6.0 states that every nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating (it contains a norm-one vector), so it has an orthonormal basis; the plane-absorption construction is only cited through the line-1087 quote, not described.
S1.4.2 gives the exact ratios L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539.
The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors, or the formula q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x]; S1.6.1 states only the resulting product of kernels.
The plan does not say that wt(v) is odd, give the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or use H diag(1,-1) H = X; it states the kernel aI+bX_v (S1.6.1) without deriving it.

S3.1b turns each residual kernel into one child operation (C^eps)^{tensor f} across the f columns of a slot, and S3.1c counts exactly s_c such child calls, which is the k-column tensored-factor count where the paper uses it (lines 1904-1906).

S1.6.4 gives the exceptional pair X_a->Y_a carrying C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u), repaired by Z via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and S1.6.3 gives the source/sink corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange; the zero-label frame I, the full-label frame C^{tensor m} and the scalar i^{27k} are not stated.
S1.4.2 states that both loss ratios are below 1/2, and S1.4/S1.4.4 conclude that the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s_b<W_b m (and likewise for the complex network).
S2.2.6.1 mentions the exact bound eta_b but never gives its value 339/22587335000000.
S2.2.6.1 mentions eta_c but never gives its value 73/19906842167500.
S2.2.6.1-S2.2.6.2 state that both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20 and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.

S2.1.1.1-S2.1.1.2 give the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower triangular elementary operations, repeating on the active indices, and a partial permutation with exactly a ones.
The plan works over Z/q^b but never chooses a fixed odd prime avoiding the denominators of a finite table of factors so that the factorizations specialize with invertible triangular factors.
S2.1.2 states that a lower triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order by a diagonal unit plus earlier coordinates.
S2.1.4-S2.1.5 give D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j sending (h,d) to (h+d,d), with one interchange per one of Pi and a in all.
S3.5 states E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, C_1=20 and the bound ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) in the guard-width role, but it does not define nu or C_0=128mB^2, and does not give C_1=max{20,nu+3}.
The plan has no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with A(e)<=8e at leaves; S3.5 only asserts the resulting bound.
The plan does not unroll the recurrence (B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}); it asserts only that growth is bounded by ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}).

S3.5 states that epsilon C_1<1 gives o(p), but it omits the depth-to-size relation (values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l) and the reservation of p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits.
S3.6 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so the final truncation keeps the unit disk with error below sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: P02 states the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the label telescoping and loss ratios (L3-L5), the matrix-shear elimination and interchange mechanics (M1, M3, M4), the rank-saving inequality (R1, R4) and the endpoint repair of the phase interface (P3, P4) in full. It omits the residual table and the h-2 side-edge residual (L1, L2), the weight-additivity and odd-weight derivation of the translation kernels (P1, P2), the exact deficit values (R2, R3) and the choice of prime (M2). The guard-width derivation (S2-S4) is reduced to its constants and its conclusion. 16 of 26 present.
